exec python3 -c "import http.server as h, os
class H(h.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def end_headers(self):
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
        super().end_headers()
h.ThreadingHTTPServer.request_queue_size = 128
h.test(HandlerClass=H, ServerClass=h.ThreadingHTTPServer, protocol='HTTP/1.1', port=int(os.environ.get('PORT', '8795')), bind='127.0.0.1')"
